    (hdir : walAreaDir s.area dir) (hnone : s.wal !! dir = none) (k : GoString) : walCreateRegion
    dir k → s.wal !! k = none

    GooseGlobalGS hlc GF] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] {st : Stuckness} {E : CoPset} (dir : GoString) (R R'
    : IProp GF) (Hupd : ∀ (s : AbsDiskState), ⊢ absDiskCtx gooseAbsDiskGS s -∗ R ==∗ absDiskCtx

    ⊢ WP (ExternalOp absDiskExt.name "WalUnlock" (Val ((intoVal dir).PairV (intoVal (walCode 0)))))

theorem Perennial.absPast_timeless [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (s : AbsDiskState) :
    Timeless (absPast s)

theorem Perennial.walMapLe_upd (G : GMap GoString WalDur) (s : AbsDiskState) (dir : GoString) (f :
    WalDur → WalDur) (hf : ∀ (d0 d : WalDur), walDurLe d0 d → walDurLe d0 (f d)) (hG : walMapLe G
    s.wal) : walMapLe G (absDiskUpd s dir f).wal

def Perennial.absLe (s s' : AbsDiskState) : Prop :=
  s'.area = s.area ∧
    (∀ (d : GoString), s.dirs !! d = some () → s'.dirs !! d = some ()) ∧
      ∀ (dir : GoString) (d : WalDur),
        s.wal !! dir = some d →
          ∃ d', s'.wal !! dir = some d' ∧ d.m ≤ d'.m ∧ d.H.length ≤ d'.H.length ∧ (d.named = true → d'.named = true)

theorem Perennial.walArea_crash [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [L :
    GooseLocalGS GF] (L' : GooseLocalGS GF) (s s' : AbsDiskState) (hc : ExtSemantics.crash s s') (r
    : GoString) : ⊢ absPastAuth gooseAbsDiskGS s -∗ absPast s' -∗ walArea r -∗ walArea r

theorem Perennial.walOptLe_trans {o1 o2 o3 : Option WalDur} (h12 : walOptLe o1 o2) (h23 : walOptLe
    o2 o3) : walOptLe o1 o3

theorem Perennial.walDiskAt_crash [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [L
    : GooseLocalGS GF] (L' : GooseLocalGS GF) (dir : GoString) (d : WalDur) (n : Nat) : ⊢
    absDiskCrashWal gooseAbsDiskGS gooseAbsDiskGS -∗ walDiskAt dir d -∗ walSyncedLb dir n -∗
    walNamed dir -∗ ∃ I k, ⌜walImg d.H n I ∧ k ≤ min d.pur I.length⌝ ∗ walDiskAt dir { H := I, m :=
    d.m, unl := min d.unl I.length, pur := min d.pur I.length, cut := k, metadata := d.metadata,
    named := d.named, sized := d.sized } ∗ walSyncedLb dir n ∗ walNamed dir

theorem Perennial.wp_absDisk_walStepR1 [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj
    GoString] [G : GooseGlobalGS hlc GF] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] {st : Stuckness} {E : CoPset} (op :
    String) (v : val) (dir : GoString) (upd : WalDur → WalDur) (Pd : WalDur → Prop) (hv : v.isPanic
    = false) (hf : ∀ (d : WalDur), d.m ≤ (upd d).m ∧ d.H.length ≤ (upd d).H.length ∧ (d.named = true
    → (upd d).named = true)) (hmono : ∀ (d d' : WalDur), walDurLe d d' → walDurLe (upd d) (upd d'))
    (hPd : ∀ (d d' : WalDur), walDurLe d d' → Pd d → Pd d') (Hprog : ∀ (h : GMap Loc (NonAtomic
    val)) (s : AbsDiskState) (g : Unit), (∀ (d : WalDur), s.wal !! dir = some d → Pd d) →
    AbsDiskStep op v h s g (Val (intoVal ())) h (absDiskUpd s dir upd) g) (Hdet : ∀ (h : GMap Loc
    (NonAtomic val)) (s : AbsDiskState) (g : Unit) (e' : Expr) (h' : GMap Loc (NonAtomic val)) (s' :
    AbsDiskState) (g' : Unit), AbsDiskStep op v h s g e' h' s' g' → h' = h ∧ e' = Val (intoVal ()) ∧
    s' = absDiskUpd s dir upd) (d : WalDur) (Hd : Pd d) (R R' : IProp GF) (Hupd : ∀ (s :
    AbsDiskState), ⊢ absDiskCtx gooseAbsDiskGS s -∗ R ==∗ absDiskCtx gooseAbsDiskGS s ∗ R') (Φ : val
    → IProp GF) : (|={E,∅}=> walDiskAt dir d ∗ R ∗ (walDiskAt dir (upd d) -∗ R' -∗ ∀ s', absPast s'
    -∗ ⌜∃ d', s'.wal !! dir = some d' ∧ walDurLe (upd d) d'⌝ -∗ ▷ |={∅,E}=> Φ (intoVal ()))) ⊢ WP
    (ExternalOp absDiskExt.name op (Val v)) @ st ; E {{ Φ }}

theorem Perennial.absDiskUpd_unl0 (s : AbsDiskState) (dir : GoString) : (absDiskUpd s dir fun d => {
    H := d.H, m := d.m, unl := max d.unl 0, pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut, metadata := d.metadata,
    named := d.named, sized := d.sized }) = s

    WalOpG WalEnt) {d d' : WalDur} (h : walDurLe d d') : walDurLe { H := d.H ++ [o], m := d.m, unl
    := d.unl, pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut, metadata := d.metadata, named := d.named, sized := d.sized
    } { H := d'.H ++ [o], m := d'.m, unl := d'.unl, pur := d'.pur, cut := d'.cut, metadata :=
    d'.metadata, named := d'.named, sized := d'.sized }

def Perennial.walOptLe : Option WalDur → Option WalDur → Prop :=
  match x✝¹, x✝ with
  | none, none => True
  | some d, some d' => walDurLe d d'
  | x, x_1 => False

theorem Perennial.wp_absDisk_walStep [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString]
    [G : GooseGlobalGS hlc GF] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] {st : Stuckness} {E : CoPset} (op : String) (v
    : val) (dir : GoString) (upd : WalDur → WalDur) (Pd : WalDur → Prop) (hv : v.isPanic = false)
    (hf : ∀ (d : WalDur), d.m ≤ (upd d).m ∧ d.H.length ≤ (upd d).H.length ∧ (d.named = true → (upd
    d).named = true)) (hmono : ∀ (d d' : WalDur), walDurLe d d' → walDurLe (upd d) (upd d')) (hPd :
    ∀ (d d' : WalDur), walDurLe d d' → Pd d → Pd d') (Hprog : ∀ (h : GMap Loc (NonAtomic val)) (s :
    AbsDiskState) (g : Unit), (∀ (d : WalDur), s.wal !! dir = some d → Pd d) → AbsDiskStep op v h s
    g (Val (intoVal ())) h (absDiskUpd s dir upd) g) (Hdet : ∀ (h : GMap Loc (NonAtomic val)) (s :
    AbsDiskState) (g : Unit) (e' : Expr) (h' : GMap Loc (NonAtomic val)) (s' : AbsDiskState) (g' :
    Unit), AbsDiskStep op v h s g e' h' s' g' → h' = h ∧ e' = Val (intoVal ()) ∧ s' = absDiskUpd s
    dir upd) (d : WalDur) (Hd : Pd d) (Φ : val → IProp GF) : (|={E,∅}=> walDiskAt dir d ∗ (walDiskAt
    dir (upd d) -∗ ∀ s', absPast s' -∗ ⌜∃ d', s'.wal !! dir = some d' ∧ walDurLe (upd d) d'⌝ -∗ ▷
    |={∅,E}=> Φ (intoVal ()))) ⊢ WP (ExternalOp absDiskExt.name op (Val v)) @ st ; E {{ Φ }}

theorem Perennial.wp_WalNamedOpen [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [G
    : GooseGlobalGS hlc GF] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] {st : Stuckness} {E : CoPset} (w : Loc) (dir :
    GoString) (s : w64 × w64) (d : WalDur) (Φ : val → IProp GF) : (|={E,∅}=> walDiskAt dir d ∗
    walOpening w dir s ∗ (walDiskAt dir { H := d.H, m := d.m, unl := d.unl, pur := d.pur, cut :=
    d.cut, metadata := d.metadata, named := true, sized := d.sized } -∗ walOpenW w dir ∗ walPurgeW w
    dir -∗ ∀ s', absPast s' -∗ ⌜∃ d', s'.wal !! dir = some d' ∧ walDurLe { H := d.H, m := d.m, unl
    := d.unl, pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut, metadata := d.metadata, named := true, sized := d.sized }
    d'⌝ -∗ ▷ |={∅,E}=> Φ (intoVal ()))) ⊢ WP (ExternalOp absDiskExt.name "WalNamed" (Val (intoVal
    dir))) @ st ; E {{ Φ }}

theorem Perennial.walMapLe_refl (M : GMap GoString WalDur) : walMapLe M M

def Perennial.dirDurable [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (d : GoString) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ s, absPast s ∗ ⌜s.dirs !! d = some ()⌝)

def Perennial.walSyncedLb [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (dir : GoString) (n : Nat) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ s d, absPast s ∗ ⌜s.wal !! dir = some d ∧ n ≤ d.m⌝)

    unl := d'.unl, pur := d'.pur, cut := d'.cut, metadata := d'.metadata, named := true, sized :=
    d'.sized }

  token gooseAbsDiskGS.γu

theorem Perennial.walOwn_excl [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [L :
    GooseLocalGS GF] (M M' : GMap GoString WalDur) : ⊢ walOwn M -∗ walOwn M' -∗ False

    IProp GF :=
  walDirIs dir (some d)

theorem Perennial.walDiskAt_crash_keep [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj
    GoString] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (L' : GooseLocalGS GF) (dir : GoString) (d : WalDur) (n : Nat) :
    ⊢ absDiskCrashWal gooseAbsDiskGS gooseAbsDiskGS -∗ walDiskAt dir d -∗ walSyncedLb dir n -∗
    walNamed dir -∗ walDiskAt dir d ∗ ∃ I k, ⌜walImg d.H n I ∧ k ≤ min d.pur I.length⌝ ∗ walDiskAt
    dir { H := I, m := d.m, unl := min d.unl I.length, pur := min d.pur I.length, cut := k, metadata
    := d.metadata, named := d.named, sized := d.sized } ∗ walSyncedLb dir n ∗ walNamed dir

theorem Perennial.wp_WalAppend [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [G :
    GooseGlobalGS hlc GF] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] {st : Stuckness} {E : CoPset} (dir : GoString) (o :
    WalOpG WalEnt) (d : WalDur) (Φ : val → IProp GF) : (|={E,∅}=> walDiskAt dir d ∗ (walDiskAt dir {
    H := d.H ++ [o], m := d.m, unl := d.unl, pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut, metadata := d.metadata,
    named := d.named, sized := d.sized } -∗ ∀ s', absPast s' -∗ ⌜∃ d', s'.wal !! dir = some d' ∧
    walDurLe { H := d.H ++ [o], m := d.m, unl := d.unl, pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut, metadata :=
    d.metadata, named := d.named, sized := d.sized } d'⌝ -∗ ▷ |={∅,E}=> Φ (intoVal ()))) ⊢ WP
    (ExternalOp absDiskExt.name "WalAppend" (Val ((intoVal dir).PairV (intoVal (walCode o))))) @ st
    ; E {{ Φ }}

def Perennial.instCountableWalMode : Pos.Countable WalMode :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective
    (fun m =>
      Pos.Countable.encode
        (match m with
        | WalMode.append => none
        | WalMode.opening s => some (some s)
        | WalMode.failed => some none))
    instCountableWalMode._proof_3

theorem Perennial.absDisk_local_crash (hPre : AbsDiskGpreS GF) (hL : AbsDiskGS GF) (s s' :
    AbsDiskState) (hc : ExtSemantics.crash s s') : ⊢ absDiskCtx hL s ==∗ ∃ hL', absDiskCtx hL' s' ∗
    absDiskCrashStart hL hL'

theorem Perennial.walOwn_timeless [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (M : GMap GoString
    WalDur) : Timeless (walOwn M)

theorem Perennial.walOpening_lenLb [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [L
    : GooseLocalGS GF] (w : Loc) (dir : GoString) (sn : w64 × w64) (s : AbsDiskState) (d : WalDur)
    (n : Nat) (hd : s.wal !! dir = some d) (hn : n ≤ d.H.length) : ⊢ walOpening w dir sn -∗ absPast
    s -∗ walOpening w dir sn ∗ walLenLb w dir n

theorem Perennial.absDiskCtx_keys [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [L
    : GooseLocalGS GF] (s : AbsDiskState) : ⊢ absDiskCtx gooseAbsDiskGS s -∗ ⌜walKeysInArea s⌝

theorem Perennial.absDisk_upd [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [L :
    GooseLocalGS GF] (s s' : AbsDiskState) (M : GMap GoString WalDur) (hle : absLe s s') (hk :
    walKeysInArea s → walKeysInArea s') : ⊢ absDiskCtx gooseAbsDiskGS s -∗ walOwn M ==∗ ⌜walMapLe M
    s.wal⌝ ∗ absDiskCtx gooseAbsDiskGS s' ∗ walOwn s'.wal ∗ absPast s'

def Perennial.absPastAuth (hL : AbsDiskGS GF) (s : AbsDiskState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ F,
      ghostMapAuth hL.γf 1 F ∗
        ([∗map] p ↦ _u ∈ F, p ↪[hL.γf]□ ()) ∗ ⌜∀ (p : AbsDiskState), F !! p = some () → absLe p s⌝ ∗ () ↪[hL.γa]□ s.area)

theorem Perennial.walAbsent_crash_keep [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj
    GoString] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (L' : GooseLocalGS GF) (dir : GoString) : ⊢ absDiskCrashWal
    gooseAbsDiskGS gooseAbsDiskGS -∗ walAbsent dir -∗ walAbsent dir ∗ walAbsent dir

theorem Perennial.wp_WalCloseHandle [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString]
    [G : GooseGlobalGS hlc GF] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] {st : Stuckness} {E : CoPset} (w : Loc) (dir :
    GoString) (s : w64 × w64) (Φ : val → IProp GF) : (|={E,∅}=> (walOpenW w dir ∗ walPurgeW w dir ∨
    walOpening w dir s ∨ walReadFailed w dir) ∗ (walUnlockedTok -∗ ▷ |={∅,E}=> Φ (intoVal ()))) ⊢ WP
    (ExternalOp absDiskExt.name "WalUnlock" (Val ((intoVal dir).PairV (intoVal (walCode 0))))) @ st
    ; E {{ Φ }}

def Perennial.absDisk_interp : ExtInterp absDiskExt :=
  { LocalGS := AbsDiskGS, GlobalGS := fun x => Unit, localCtx := fun {GF} => absDiskCtx,
    globalCtx := fun {GF} x x_1 => iprop(True), PreG := AbsDiskGpreS, initgP := fun x => True,
    initP := fun s x => absDiskInitOk s, globalStart := fun {GF} x x_1 => iprop(True),
    localStart := fun {GF} => absDiskStart, global_init := ⋯, local_init := absDisk_interp._proof_2 }

def Perennial.instCountableWalDur : Pos.Countable WalDur :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun d => Pos.Countable.encode (d.H, d.m, d.unl, d.pur, d.cut, d.metadata, d.named, d.sized))
    instCountableWalDur._proof_1

def Perennial.walKeysInArea (s : AbsDiskState) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : GoString) (d : WalDur), s.wal !! k = some d → walAreaDir s.area k

theorem Perennial.walDurLe_refl (d : WalDur) : walDurLe d d

theorem Perennial.walDiskAt_crash_any [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString]
    [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (L' : GooseLocalGS GF) (dir : GoString) (d : WalDur) (n : Nat) : ⊢
    absDiskCrashWal gooseAbsDiskGS gooseAbsDiskGS -∗ walDiskAt dir d -∗ walSyncedLb dir n -∗
    walAbsent dir ∗ ⌜d.named = false⌝ ∨ ∃ I k, ⌜walImg d.H n I ∧ k ≤ min d.pur I.length⌝ ∗ walDiskAt
    dir { H := I, m := d.m, unl := min d.unl I.length, pur := min d.pur I.length, cut := k, metadata
    := d.metadata, named := d.named, sized := d.sized } ∗ walSyncedLb dir n

theorem Perennial.walArea_crash_keep [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString]
    [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (L' : GooseLocalGS GF) (r : GoString) : ⊢ absDiskCrashWal gooseAbsDiskGS
    gooseAbsDiskGS -∗ walArea r -∗ absDiskCrashWal gooseAbsDiskGS gooseAbsDiskGS ∗ walArea r

theorem Perennial.absDisk_local_init (hPre : AbsDiskGpreS GF) (s : AbsDiskState) (hk : walKeysInArea
    s) : ⊢ |==> ∃ hL, absDiskCtx hL s ∗ absDiskStart hL s

theorem Perennial.dirDurable_crash [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [L
    : GooseLocalGS GF] (L' : GooseLocalGS GF) (s s' : AbsDiskState) (hc : ExtSemantics.crash s s')
    (d : GoString) : ⊢ absPastAuth gooseAbsDiskGS s -∗ absPast s' -∗ dirDurable d -∗ dirDurable d

theorem Perennial.absPast_snap (hL : AbsDiskGS GF) (s : AbsDiskState) : ⊢ absPastAuth hL s ==∗
    absPastAuth hL s ∗ absPastAt hL s

theorem Perennial.absDisk_local_ctx_eq [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj
    GoString] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (s : AbsDiskState) : ExtInterp.localCtx (extLocalGS absDiskExt)
    s ⊣⊢ absDiskCtx gooseAbsDiskGS s

def Perennial.walAbsent [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (dir : GoString) : IProp GF :=
  walDirIs dir none

theorem Perennial.walOptLe_none_iff (o : Option WalDur) : walOptLe none o ↔ o = none

theorem Perennial.dirDurable_crash_keep [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj
    GoString] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (L' : GooseLocalGS GF) (d : GoString) : ⊢ absDiskCrashWal
    gooseAbsDiskGS gooseAbsDiskGS -∗ dirDurable d -∗ absDiskCrashWal gooseAbsDiskGS gooseAbsDiskGS ∗
    dirDurable d

theorem Perennial.walArea_ctx [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [L :
    GooseLocalGS GF] (s : AbsDiskState) (r : GoString) : ⊢ absDiskCtx gooseAbsDiskGS s -∗ walArea r
    -∗ ⌜s.area = r⌝

theorem Perennial.wp_WalNamed [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [G :
    GooseGlobalGS hlc GF] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] {st : Stuckness} {E : CoPset} (dir : GoString) (d :
    WalDur) (Φ : val → IProp GF) : (|={E,∅}=> walDiskAt dir d ∗ (walDiskAt dir { H := d.H, m := d.m,
    unl := d.unl, pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut, metadata := d.metadata, named := true, sized :=
    d.sized } -∗ ∀ s', absPast s' -∗ ⌜∃ d', s'.wal !! dir = some d' ∧ walDurLe { H := d.H, m := d.m,
    unl := d.unl, pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut, metadata := d.metadata, named := true, sized :=
    d.sized } d'⌝ -∗ ▷ |={∅,E}=> Φ (intoVal ()))) ⊢ WP (ExternalOp absDiskExt.name "WalNamed" (Val
    (intoVal dir))) @ st ; E {{ Φ }}

theorem Perennial.absDisk_crash_view_keep [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj
    GoString] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (L' : GooseLocalGS GF) (M : GMap GoString WalDur) : ⊢
    absDiskCrashWal gooseAbsDiskGS gooseAbsDiskGS -∗ walOwn M -∗ walOwn M ∗ ∃ s s',
    ⌜ExtSemantics.crash s s' ∧ walMapLe M s.wal⌝ ∗ absPastAuth gooseAbsDiskGS s ∗ walOwn s'.wal ∗
    absPast s'

theorem Perennial.absDiskUpd_wal (s : AbsDiskState) (dir : GoString) (f : WalDur → WalDur) (d :
    WalDur) (hd : s.wal !! dir = some d) : (absDiskUpd s dir f).wal = <[dir := f d]>s.wal

theorem Perennial.walOptLe_some_iff (d : WalDur) (o : Option WalDur) : walOptLe (some d) o ↔ ∃ d', o
    = some d' ∧ walDurLe d d'

def Perennial.instCountableAbsDiskState : Pos.Countable AbsDiskState :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun s => Pos.Countable.encode (s.area, s.wal, s.dirs)) instCountableAbsDiskState._proof_1

def (sealed) Perennial.walOpening [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (w : Loc) (dir :
    GoString) (s : w64 × w64) : IProp GF

theorem Perennial.walSyncedLb_mono [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [L
    : GooseLocalGS GF] (dir : GoString) (n n' : Nat) (h : n' ≤ n) : ⊢ walSyncedLb dir n -∗
    walSyncedLb dir n'

theorem Perennial.absDisk_crash_view [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString]
    [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (L' : GooseLocalGS GF) (M : GMap GoString WalDur) : ⊢ absDiskCrashWal
    gooseAbsDiskGS gooseAbsDiskGS -∗ walOwn M -∗ ∃ s s', ⌜ExtSemantics.crash s s' ∧ walMapLe M
    s.wal⌝ ∗ absPastAuth gooseAbsDiskGS s ∗ walOwn s'.wal ∗ absPast s'

def (sealed) Perennial.walHandleP [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (w : Loc) (dir :
    GoString) (m : WalMode) : IProp GF

theorem Perennial.wp_absDisk_step [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [G
    : GooseGlobalGS hlc GF] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] {st : Stuckness} {E : CoPset} (op : String) (v :
    val) (P : AbsDiskState → Prop) (f : AbsDiskState → AbsDiskState) (hv : v.isPanic = false) (Hprog
    : ∀ (h : GMap Loc (NonAtomic val)) (s : AbsDiskState) (g : Unit), P s → AbsDiskStep op v h s g
    (Val (intoVal ())) h (f s) g) (Hdet : ∀ (h : GMap Loc (NonAtomic val)) (s : AbsDiskState) (g :
    Unit) (e' : Expr) (h' : GMap Loc (NonAtomic val)) (s' : AbsDiskState) (g' : Unit), AbsDiskStep
    op v h s g e' h' s' g' → h' = h ∧ e' = Val (intoVal ()) ∧ s' = f s) (Φ : val → IProp GF) :
    (|={E,∅}=> ∀ s, absDiskCtx gooseAbsDiskGS s ==∗ ⌜P s⌝ ∗ absDiskCtx gooseAbsDiskGS (f s) ∗ ▷
    |={∅,E}=> Φ (intoVal ())) ⊢ WP (ExternalOp absDiskExt.name op (Val v)) @ st ; E {{ Φ }}

def Perennial.walDurLe (d d' : WalDur) : Prop :=
  d.H = d'.H ∧
    d.unl = d'.unl ∧
      d.pur = d'.pur ∧
        d.cut = d'.cut ∧ d.metadata = d'.metadata ∧ d.sized = d'.sized ∧ d.m ≤ d'.m ∧ (d.named = true → d'.named = true)

theorem Perennial.absLe_refl (s : AbsDiskState) : absLe s s

theorem Perennial.walHandleDir_persistent [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (w : Loc) (dir :
    GoString) (γ : GName) : Persistent (walHandleDir w dir γ)

theorem Perennial.walAbsent_crash [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [L
    : GooseLocalGS GF] (L' : GooseLocalGS GF) (dir : GoString) : ⊢ absDiskCrashWal gooseAbsDiskGS
    gooseAbsDiskGS -∗ walAbsent dir -∗ walAbsent dir

theorem Perennial.wp_WalCreate [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [G :
    GooseGlobalGS hlc GF] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] {st : Stuckness} {E : CoPset} (w : Loc) (r dir :
    GoString) (md : List w8) (hdir : walAreaDir r dir) (Φ : val → IProp GF) : (walArea r ∗
    walUnlockedTok ∗ |={E,∅}=> walAbsent dir ∗ (walDiskAt dir (walDurFresh md) -∗ walOpenW w dir -∗
    walPurgeW w dir -∗ ∀ s', absPast s' -∗ ⌜s'.wal !! dir = some (walDurFresh md)⌝ -∗ ▷ |={∅,E}=> Φ
    (intoVal ()))) ⊢ WP (ExternalOp absDiskExt.name "WalCreate" (Val ((intoVal dir).PairV (intoVal
    md)))) @ st ; E {{ Φ }}

theorem Perennial.walNamed_persistent [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (dir : GoString) :
    Persistent (walNamed dir)

theorem Perennial.absLe_trans {s1 s2 s3 : AbsDiskState} (h12 : absLe s1 s2) (h23 : absLe s2 s3) :
    absLe s1 s3

def (sealed) Perennial.walReadFailed [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (w : Loc) (dir :
    GoString) : IProp GF

theorem Perennial.walKeysInArea_upd (s : AbsDiskState) (dir : GoString) (f : WalDur → WalDur) (hk :
    walKeysInArea s) : walKeysInArea (absDiskUpd s dir f)

def Perennial.walMapLe (M M' : GMap GoString WalDur) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : GoString), walOptLe (M !! k) (M' !! k)

theorem Perennial.walPurgeW_excl [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [L :
    GooseLocalGS GF] (w : Loc) (dir : GoString) (γ : GName) : ⊢ γ ↪[gooseAbsDiskGS.γhp] () -∗ γ
    ↪[gooseAbsDiskGS.γhp] () -∗ False

def Perennial.walHandleSt [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (w : Loc) (dir : GoString) (m :
    WalMode) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γ, walHandleDir w dir γ ∗ γ ↪[gooseAbsDiskGS.γh] m)

theorem Perennial.walDiskAt_crash_real [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj
    GoString] {M : GMap GoString WalDur} {s : AbsDiskState} {dir : GoString} {d : WalDur} (HMd :
    walOptLe (some d) (M !! dir)) (HMs : walMapLe M s.wal) : ∃ dr, s.wal !! dir = some dr ∧ walDurLe
    d dr

def Perennial.absPastAt (hL : AbsDiskGS GF) (s : AbsDiskState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(s ↪[hL.γf]□ () ∗ () ↪[hL.γa]□ s.area)

def Perennial.absDiskCrashWal (hL hL' : AbsDiskGS GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ s s',
      ⌜ExtSemantics.crash s s'⌝ ∗
        (∃ G, ghostVar hL.γs (Qp.half 1) G ∗ ⌜walMapLe G s.wal⌝) ∗
          absPastAuth hL s ∗ walOwnAt hL' s'.wal ∗ absPastAt hL' s')

theorem Perennial.absPast_ctx_le [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [L :
    GooseLocalGS GF] (s p : AbsDiskState) : ⊢ absDiskCtx gooseAbsDiskGS s -∗ absPast p -∗ ⌜absLe p
    s⌝

theorem Perennial.walDiskAt_crash_any_keep [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj
    GoString] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (L' : GooseLocalGS GF) (dir : GoString) (d : WalDur) (n : Nat) :
    ⊢ absDiskCrashWal gooseAbsDiskGS gooseAbsDiskGS -∗ walDiskAt dir d -∗ walSyncedLb dir n -∗
    walDiskAt dir d ∗ (walAbsent dir ∗ ⌜d.named = false⌝ ∨ ∃ I k, ⌜walImg d.H n I ∧ k ≤ min d.pur
    I.length⌝ ∗ walDiskAt dir { H := I, m := d.m, unl := min d.unl I.length, pur := min d.pur
    I.length, cut := k, metadata := d.metadata, named := d.named, sized := d.sized } ∗ walSyncedLb
    dir n)

theorem Perennial.walSyncedLb_timeless [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (dir : GoString) (n
    : Nat) : Timeless (walSyncedLb dir n)

theorem Perennial.walSyncedLb_persistent [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (dir : GoString)
    (n : Nat) : Persistent (walSyncedLb dir n)

theorem Perennial.wp_WalSyncLen [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [G :
    GooseGlobalGS hlc GF] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] {st : Stuckness} {E : CoPset} (w : Loc) (dir :
    GoString) (n : Nat) (Φ : val → IProp GF) : (walLenLb w dir n ∗ |={E,∅}=> walSyncedLb dir n -∗ ▷
    |={∅,E}=> Φ (intoVal ())) ⊢ WP (ExternalOp absDiskExt.name "WalSync" (Val ((intoVal dir).PairV
    (intoVal (walCode n))))) @ st ; E {{ Φ }}

theorem Perennial.absDiskUpd_area (s : AbsDiskState) (dir : GoString) (f : WalDur → WalDur) :
    (absDiskUpd s dir f).area = s.area

theorem Perennial.walDiskAt_crash_any_keep0 [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj
    GoString] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (L' : GooseLocalGS GF) (dir : GoString) (d : WalDur) : ⊢
    absDiskCrashWal gooseAbsDiskGS gooseAbsDiskGS -∗ walDiskAt dir d -∗ walDiskAt dir d ∗ (walAbsent
    dir ∗ ⌜d.named = false⌝ ∨ ∃ I k, ⌜walImg d.H 0 I ∧ k ≤ min d.pur I.length⌝ ∗ walDiskAt dir { H
    := I, m := d.m, unl := min d.unl I.length, pur := min d.pur I.length, cut := k, metadata :=
    d.metadata, named := d.named, sized := d.sized })

theorem Perennial.absDisk_upd_dirs [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [L
    : GooseLocalGS GF] (s s' : AbsDiskState) (hw : s'.wal = s.wal) (hle : absLe s s') : ⊢ absDiskCtx
    gooseAbsDiskGS s ==∗ absDiskCtx gooseAbsDiskGS s' ∗ absPast s'

theorem Perennial.walDiskAt_weaken [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [L
    : GooseLocalGS GF] (dir : GoString) (d d' : WalDur) (h : walDurLe d d') : ⊢ walDiskAt dir d' -∗
    walDiskAt dir d

inductive Perennial.WalMode : Type
  | Perennial.WalMode.append : WalMode
  | Perennial.WalMode.opening (s : w64 × w64) : WalMode
  | Perennial.WalMode.failed : WalMode

theorem Perennial.walDurLe_crash [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] {d
    dr : WalDur} {I : List (WalOpG WalEnt)} {k : Nat} (hle : walDurLe d dr) : walDurLe { H := I, m
    := d.m, unl := min d.unl I.length, pur := min d.pur I.length, cut := k, metadata := d.metadata,
    named := d.named, sized := d.sized } { H := I, m := dr.m, unl := min dr.unl I.length, pur := min
    dr.pur I.length, cut := k, metadata := dr.metadata, named := dr.named, sized := dr.sized }

def Perennial.walPurgeW [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (w : Loc) (dir : GoString) : IProp
    GF :=
  iprop(∃ γ, walHandleDir w dir γ ∗ γ ↪[gooseAbsDiskGS.γhp] ())

theorem Perennial.absPast_le (hL : AbsDiskGS GF) (s p : AbsDiskState) : ⊢ absPastAuth hL s -∗
    absPastAt hL p -∗ ⌜absLe p s⌝

theorem Perennial.walKeysInArea_crash {s s' : AbsDiskState} (hc : ExtSemantics.crash s s') (hk :
    walKeysInArea s) : walKeysInArea s'

theorem Perennial.wp_WalAppendAcc [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [G
    : GooseGlobalGS hlc GF] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] {st : Stuckness} {E : CoPset} (dir : GoString) (o
    : WalOpG WalEnt) (Φ : val → IProp GF) : (|={E,∅}=> ∃ d, walDiskAt dir d ∗ (walDiskAt dir { H :=
    d.H ++ [o], m := d.m, unl := d.unl, pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut, metadata := d.metadata, named :=
    d.named, sized := d.sized } -∗ ∀ s', absPast s' -∗ ⌜∃ d', s'.wal !! dir = some d' ∧ walDurLe { H
    := d.H ++ [o], m := d.m, unl := d.unl, pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut, metadata := d.metadata, named
    := d.named, sized := d.sized } d'⌝ -∗ ▷ |={∅,E}=> Φ (intoVal ()))) ⊢ WP (ExternalOp
    absDiskExt.name "WalAppend" (Val ((intoVal dir).PairV (intoVal (walCode o))))) @ st ; E {{ Φ }}

def Perennial.walDirIs [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (dir : GoString) (o : Option
    WalDur) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ M, walOwn M ∗ ⌜walOptLe o (M !! dir)⌝)

theorem Perennial.walDurLe_upd_unl [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] (p
    : Nat) {d d' : WalDur} (h : walDurLe d d') : walDurLe { H := d.H, m := d.m, unl := max d.unl p,
    pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut, metadata := d.metadata, named := d.named, sized := d.sized } { H :=
    d'.H, m := d'.m, unl := max d'.unl p, pur := d'.pur, cut := d'.cut, metadata := d'.metadata,
    named := d'.named, sized := d'.sized }

def Perennial.walNamed [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (dir : GoString) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ s d, absPast s ∗ ⌜s.wal !! dir = some d ∧ d.named = true⌝)

def Perennial.absDiskCrashStart (hL hL' : AbsDiskGS GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(absDiskCrashWal hL hL' ∗ token hL'.γu)

theorem Perennial.wp_WalPurge [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [G :
    GooseGlobalGS hlc GF] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] {st : Stuckness} {E : CoPset} (dir : GoString) (k :
    Nat) (d : WalDur) (Hk : d.cut ≤ k ∧ k ≤ max d.pur d.unl) (Φ : val → IProp GF) : (|={E,∅}=>
    walDiskAt dir d ∗ (walDiskAt dir { H := d.H, m := d.m, unl := d.unl, pur := max d.pur d.unl, cut
    := k, metadata := d.metadata, named := d.named, sized := d.sized } -∗ ∀ s', absPast s' -∗ ⌜∃ d',
    s'.wal !! dir = some d' ∧ walDurLe { H := d.H, m := d.m, unl := d.unl, pur := max d.pur d.unl,
    cut := k, metadata := d.metadata, named := d.named, sized := d.sized } d'⌝ -∗ ▷ |={∅,E}=> Φ
    (intoVal ()))) ⊢ WP (ExternalOp absDiskExt.name "WalPurge" (Val ((intoVal dir).PairV (intoVal
    (walCode k))))) @ st ; E {{ Φ }}

theorem Perennial.wp_WalReadFail [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [G :

    ((intoVal dir).PairV (intoVal (walCode 0))))) @ st ; E {{ Φ }}

theorem Perennial.walNamed_timeless [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (dir : GoString) :
    Timeless (walNamed dir)

    := d.H, m := d.m, unl := max d.unl p, pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut, metadata := d.metadata, named

    absDiskExt.name "WalUnlock" (Val ((intoVal dir).PairV (intoVal (walCode p))))) @ st ; E {{ Φ }}

theorem Perennial.wp_WalOpenHandle [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [G
    : GooseGlobalGS hlc GF] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] {st : Stuckness} {E : CoPset} (w : Loc) (dir :
    GoString) (s : w64 × w64) (p : Nat) (d : WalDur) (Φ : val → IProp GF) : (|={E,∅}=> walDiskAt dir

    := d.cut, metadata := d.metadata, named := d.named, sized := d.sized } -∗ walOpening w dir s -∗

    d.unl p, pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut, metadata := d.metadata, named := d.named, sized := d.sized
    } d'⌝ -∗ ▷ |={∅,E}=> Φ (intoVal ()))) ⊢ WP (ExternalOp absDiskExt.name "WalUnlock" (Val
    ((intoVal dir).PairV (intoVal (walCode p))))) @ st ; E {{ Φ }}

def Perennial.instDecidableEqAbsDiskState : DecidableEq AbsDiskState :=
  Classical.propDecidable (a = b)

theorem Perennial.absPast_persistent [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (s : AbsDiskState) :
    Persistent (absPast s)

def Perennial.walArea [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (r : GoString) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ s, absPast s ∗ ⌜s.area = r⌝)

theorem Perennial.walLenLb_persistent [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (w : Loc) (dir :
    GoString) (n : Nat) : Persistent (walLenLb w dir n)

def Perennial.walLenLb [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (w : Loc) (dir : GoString) (n :
    Nat) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γ s d, walHandleDir w dir γ ∗ absPast s ∗ ⌜s.wal !! dir = some d ∧ n ≤ d.H.length⌝)

theorem Perennial.wp_WalSync [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [G :
    GooseGlobalGS hlc GF] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] {st : Stuckness} {E : CoPset} (dir : GoString) (n :
    Nat) (d : WalDur) (Hn : n ≤ d.H.length) (Φ : val → IProp GF) : (|={E,∅}=> walDiskAt dir d ∗
    (walDiskAt dir { H := d.H, m := max d.m n, unl := d.unl, pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut, metadata :=
    d.metadata, named := d.named, sized := d.sized } -∗ ∀ s', absPast s' -∗ ⌜∃ d', s'.wal !! dir =
    some d' ∧ walDurLe { H := d.H, m := max d.m n, unl := d.unl, pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut,
    metadata := d.metadata, named := d.named, sized := d.sized } d'⌝ -∗ ▷ |={∅,E}=> Φ (intoVal ())))
    ⊢ WP (ExternalOp absDiskExt.name "WalSync" (Val ((intoVal dir).PairV (intoVal (walCode n))))) @
    st ; E {{ Φ }}

def Perennial.absDiskCtx (hL : AbsDiskGS GF) (s : AbsDiskState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((∃ G, ghostVar hL.γs (Qp.half 1) G ∗ ⌜walMapLe G s.wal⌝) ∗
      absPastAuth hL s ∗ absHandleAuth hL ∗ ⌜walKeysInArea s⌝)

def Perennial.absDisk_crash_interp : ExtCrashInterp absDiskExt :=
  { crashStart := fun {GF} hL hL' => absDiskCrashStart hL hL', local_crash := ⋯ }

theorem Perennial.walLenLb_mono [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString] [L :
    GooseLocalGS GF] (w : Loc) (dir : GoString) (n n' : Nat) (h : n' ≤ n) : ⊢ walLenLb w dir n -∗
    walLenLb w dir n'

def (sealed) Perennial.absHandleAuth (hL : AbsDiskGS GF) : IProp GF

theorem Perennial.absPastAt_persistent (hL : AbsDiskGS GF) (s : AbsDiskState) : Persistent
    (absPastAt hL s)

theorem Perennial.wp_absDisk_walStepR [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString]
    [G : GooseGlobalGS hlc GF] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] {st : Stuckness} {E : CoPset} (op : String) (v
    : val) (dir : GoString) (upd : WalDur → WalDur) (Pd : WalDur → Prop) (hv : v.isPanic = false)
    (hf : ∀ (d : WalDur), d.m ≤ (upd d).m ∧ d.H.length ≤ (upd d).H.length ∧ (d.named = true → (upd
    d).named = true)) (hmono : ∀ (d d' : WalDur), walDurLe d d' → walDurLe (upd d) (upd d')) (hPd :
    ∀ (d d' : WalDur), walDurLe d d' → Pd d → Pd d') (Hprog : ∀ (h : GMap Loc (NonAtomic val)) (s :
    AbsDiskState) (g : Unit), (∀ (d : WalDur), s.wal !! dir = some d → Pd d) → AbsDiskStep op v h s
    g (Val (intoVal ())) h (absDiskUpd s dir upd) g) (Hdet : ∀ (h : GMap Loc (NonAtomic val)) (s :
    AbsDiskState) (g : Unit) (e' : Expr) (h' : GMap Loc (NonAtomic val)) (s' : AbsDiskState) (g' :
    Unit), AbsDiskStep op v h s g e' h' s' g' → h' = h ∧ e' = Val (intoVal ()) ∧ s' = absDiskUpd s
    dir upd) (R R' : IProp GF) (Hupd : ∀ (s : AbsDiskState), ⊢ absDiskCtx gooseAbsDiskGS s -∗ R ==∗
    absDiskCtx gooseAbsDiskGS s ∗ R') (Φ : val → IProp GF) : (|={E,∅}=> ∃ d, ⌜Pd d⌝ ∗ walDiskAt dir
    d ∗ R ∗ (walDiskAt dir (upd d) -∗ R' -∗ ∀ s', absPast s' -∗ ⌜∃ d', s'.wal !! dir = some d' ∧
    walDurLe (upd d) d'⌝ -∗ ▷ |={∅,E}=> Φ (intoVal ()))) ⊢ WP (ExternalOp absDiskExt.name op (Val
    v)) @ st ; E {{ Φ }}

theorem Perennial.walUnlockedTok_timeless [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] : Timeless
    walUnlockedTok

def Perennial.gooseAbsDiskGS [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] : AbsDiskGS GF :=
  extLocalGS absDiskExt

theorem Perennial.dirDurable_timeless [HasExt absDiskExt] [L : GooseLocalGS GF] (d : GoString) :
    Timeless (dirDurable d)

theorem Perennial.walDurLe_upd_purge [HasExt absDiskExt] [GoGlobalContext] [go.IntoValInj GoString]
    (k : Nat) {d d' : WalDur} (h : walDurLe d d') : walDurLe { H := d.H, m := d.m, unl := d.unl, pur
    := max d.pur d.unl, cut := k, metadata := d.metadata, named := d.named, sized := d.sized } { H
    := d'.H, m := d'.m, unl := d'.unl, pur := max d'.pur d'.unl, cut := k, metadata := d'.metadata,
    named := d'.named, sized := d'.sized }
